pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/cron/digest/route.test.ts:100 The digest route suite mocks @/lib/alerts with hand-restated copies of real helpers (digestMovementFields, sinkKindForOrg) and with defaults that pass (dispatchAlert → true, digestHasSignal → true), so the route is tested against a fork that will not follow a change to the shipped helpers.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/cron/digest/route.test.ts:100 The mock re-implements digestMovementFields; the real one (src/lib/alerts.ts:163) goes through isMeasurableDigestCohort. The rule is to share the construction function instead (importActual), and the fake also defaults to 'satisfied' (line 99, digestHasSignal → true).
src/lib/alerts.test.ts:70 The cooldown window is proved with an injected clock value, not wall time, so load cannot make it flake.
